title: Fast-rising R&B artist Davis releases debut single "Under The Influence"
htmlContent:
Fast-rising R&B artist Davis is a multi-talented singer and songwriter originally from North Carolina but currently based in Los Angeles, California. This talented R&B singer/songwriter needs to be on your radar, for he is Fast making a name for himself with his fresh yet polished sound, "Under The Influence."

Davis's "Under The Influence" is a significant anthem that stops time for the listener from getting lost in this authentic experience of the music. "Under The Influence" comes with a tone that sets it vocally, which can take the song to another level to make sure we can enjoy the writing to the fullest this song that doesn't miss.
